findings.title: SQL injection (error-based) in 'id'
findings.description: Injecting into 'id' produced a database error, indicating unsanitised input reaches an SQL query.
findings.evidence: payload="'"; db-error marker='you have an error in your sql syntax'
findings.impact: Full read/modify access to the database; often leads to full system compromise.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements; never concatenate user input into SQL.

findings.title: Server-side template injection in 'name'
findings.description: Input in 'name' is evaluated by a server-side template engine (7*7 rendered as 49).
findings.impact: Template injection commonly escalates to remote code execution on the server.
findings.remediation: Never render user input as a template; use a sandboxed engine and pass data as context variables only.

findings.title: Sensitive file exposed: /.env
findings.description: The path /.env is publicly reachable and returned HTTP 200.
findings.impact: May disclose credentials, source code, or configuration that aids further attacks.
findings.remediation: Remove the file from the web root or block access via server config; rotate any leaked secrets.

findings.title: Server-side request forgery in 'url'
findings.description: The 'url' parameter made the server fetch an internal URL; the response contained internal-only content.
findings.impact: Read cloud metadata/credentials, reach internal services, and pivot into the internal network.
findings.remediation: Allowlist outbound hosts/schemes; block link-local/private ranges; do not let user input control server-side fetch targets.
